snippet.title: The 9th Dragon Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
A world premiere trailer revealed The 9th Dragon, a gorgeous voxel brawler where you topple the kingpins of Kowloon City. It's coming soon to PC and consoles.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4402330

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
